# hetznerrobot_rdns (Resource)

The reverse DNS (PTR) entry of an IPv4 address or of an address inside an IPv6 subnet. Creating it overwrites an entry that already exists; destroying it deletes the entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hetznerrobot_rdns" "main" {
  ip  = data.hetznerrobot_server.web.server_ip
  ptr = "web1.example.com"
}

# Any address inside the server's IPv6 /64 can carry its own entry.
resource "hetznerrobot_rdns" "v6" {
  ip  = "${data.hetznerrobot_server.web.server_ipv6_net}1"
  ptr = "web1.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) IP address the entry belongs to.
- `ptr` (String) PTR record, e.g. `server1.example.com`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_rdns.main 123.123.123.123
```
